entry.title: [javadimr] The negotiation-war dichotomy is not real. The general public does not want war…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

The negotiation-war dichotomy is not real. The general public does not want war at any cost or negotiation under any conditions. The main goal is to maximize national interests through a possible combination of war and negotiation, as decided by political-military officials. The street or television, without the necessary information, is not a decision-maker or evaluator; it supports the system's decision.

entry.title: [javadimr] The level of expert decision-making is far from what society expects, and there…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

The level of expert decision-making is far from what society expects, and there is no intention to persuade the public. Therefore, in wartime conditions, the most reasonable and least costly path is to avoid any manipulation of the status quo—whether regarding gasoline in Kerman, the new decision on student meals, or the misrepresentation of influence in the parliamentary bill.

entry.title: [javadimr] Trump has talked nonsense about annexing the Strait of Hormuz to America. But…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

Trump has talked nonsense about annexing the Strait of Hormuz to America. But those whose entire being is filled with hatred for the Islamic Republic—how far are they willing to go in supporting Trump? The collective nationalist spirit of Iranians will react to the disregard of regime-change advocates for Iran's national territory, just as it eliminated the MKO.
